name: Swimming pool pump, filter and cover

comps.spec: The pool: 20,000–100,000 litres — filter, then boil or disinfect before drinking
Self-priming centrifugal pump, 0.75–3 hp, 120/240V — moves 150–400 litres a minute for transfer and irrigation
The pump's induction motor, about 3,450 RPM, unbolts from the wet end
Sand, cartridge or DE filter in a pressure tank — a good pre-filter for creek or rain water, not drinking-safe on its own
Pool cover: solid winter cover or bubble solar cover — a huge tarp
comps.loc: On the pool or rolled up nearby

comps.spec: Chlorine tablets or liquid — water treatment; never mix with acid or other pool chemicals
comps.loc: Inline feeder, floater or pool shed

comps.spec: 1.5–2 in PVC pipe, unions and valves
24-hour mechanical timer with a synchronous clock motor
comps.loc: Grey timer box on the wall

boards.loc: Drive and keypad on variable-speed pumps
